children: said its subsidiary, Xiamen Airlines, signed an agreement with Boeing
on Tuesday to buy 50 Boeing 737-8 aircraft, according to a stock exchange filing.
The total list price for the jets was about $7.4 billion, but the actual purchase price would be lower, China Southern Airlines said in the filing.
This deal is subject to approval by relevant authorities, it added.
